title: Steeper Quilt
description: Optional difficulty tiers for the Steeper Quilt rule. Tier 0 preserves the BAL baseline; later tiers only steepen existing enemies and unlock after the previous tier is won.
max_hp_rounding_rule: max_hp_bonus = ceil(enemy_max_hp * max_hp_percent_bonus / 100): apply the percentage, then round the added max HP up to the next whole point. 0% adds nothing. Applies to existing normal, Elite and Boss enemies, both Boss phases included.
